note: New permission denial strings of the role and scope model. The wave merge must unwrap the `en.common` wrapper and merge the children into the central `common` namespace (do not copy the wrapper). Translate for fr, rw, sw. Interpolation tokens are shown literally in the values. The error the repository raises (ScopePermissionError) carries the machine-readable `reason` (`no_context`, `permission`, `scope`) and the `detail`; the UI maps the reason to one of the keys below and shows the detail as the parameter, so the module itself does not translate the message. The `denied` key is the message the error carries when the UI has no catalogue of its own.

permissions.noContext: the actor has no permission context
permissions.rowOutsideScope: the row is outside the scope of the roles [{{roles}}]
permissions.entityOutsideScope: the {{entity}} row is outside the scope of the roles [{{roles}}]
permissions.auditTrailOfDatabase: the audit trail of the whole database is only reachable by the roles whose scope covers the institution
